name: nft-reject-peer-drop-unrelated-above
description: reject-peer with a drop for a different address above
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.9.9.9 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 reject
